name: Indraprastha Medical Corporation Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1988 as a JV between Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Ltd. (AHEL) and the Delhi Government, Indraprastha Medical Corporation Ltd. is a super speciality tertiary care hospital in New Delhi. The Co. currently has 52 speciality departments. [1]
keyPoints:
JV of Apollo
IMCL is a JV between Apollo Hospital (22%) and the State Government of Delhi (26%), and has presence in the NCR with two facilities, a 718-bedded facility in Sarita Vihar (operational since 1996) and a 46-bedded facility in Noida (since 2006). [1]

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 29.4% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 28.3%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 30.3%
cons: Stock is trading at 7.06 times its book value
